reviews.comment: 75% of the class pertains nothing to architecture. It's basically a second studio. Very unorganized with lectures and assignments. Assignment rubrics and requirements don't match grade output most of the time. Overall, I'd rather take physics.

For being her first year teaching, she was good! The project criteria would sometimes be unclear, but she was understanding and answered questions. If you completely messed up, at least at the beginning of the year, she allowed you to redo things and update your project. All in all, I think she'll be great when she gets more experience!

As a professor teaching her first studio, she could have given more feedback and instruction. Assignments often changed midway, whether it be extended deadlines or additional assigned work. 

It was a studio class, so lots of time, work, and effort is required.

Overall a nice person. Wouldn't be my first choice, but I wouldn't mind taking again.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great prof, especially considering it's her first semester teaching. The only critique I have is that she gives a lot of freedom when it comes to projects, and sometimes it's hard to understand what you're supposed to do. However, if you ask questions, she'll give good feedback and wants you to succeed.

She's a first-year professor for first year architecture students so I didn't expect much but also didn't know what to expect, so it was honestly an overall learning experience. Very sweet, soft spoken. and she gives good advice/ insight sometimes but could be a little more informative with her critics.
